actions.name: 短幅反向北欧挺：专业确认后启用
actions.pose: Right-facing true side view. Short-range REVERSE Nordic, not a forward Nordic. She is tall-kneeling with both knees planted hip-width apart on a thin neutral gray non-slip mat, lower legs and tops of feet flat on mat behind her, white socks. Arms crossed comfortably over chest. Show a very small controlled backward lean of about 10 degrees FROM THE KNEES while hips stay extended. Knees remain fixed; knees, hips, shoulders and ears form one almost-straight gently backward-tilted line. Pelvis does not sit down toward heels. Head and neck in neutral line with trunk, no lumbar arch, no hinge at waist. Entire body and mat contact points visible.

Strict RIGHT-facing true side-view short-range REVERSE NORDIC end pose, on a thick padded gray knee mat. Both knees firmly fixed on mat, white-socked feet and lower legs lie flat behind knees extending toward image LEFT. Arms crossed on chest. Her body from KNEES to SHOULDERS is a RIGID STRAIGHT LINE tilted 15 degrees towards image LEFT, rotating at the knees. Her THIGHS MUST TILT BACKWARD together with her trunk. PELVIS MUST BE CLEARLY LEFT OF KNEES, shoulders further LEFT of pelvis, all three joints aligned with one continuous slope, NOT vertical thighs under a backward bent torso. For clear geometry, approximate frame positions are KNEE CENTER (60% width, 81% height), HIP CENTER (52% width, 54% height), SHOULDER CENTER (44% width, 29% height). This means thighs themselves tilt left 15 degrees. Torso continues their EXACT SAME SLOPE. Anatomically natural normal proportions and straight neutral spine, relaxed abdomen without back arch, not sitting onto heels. Entire head and lower legs visible. Knees stay padded, small controllable backward lean. Visual emphasis on EXTENDED HIP and TILTED THIGH, the same straight line of thigh and torso.

actions.name: 扶稳站姿交替抬膝
actions.pose: Right-facing side/very slightly oblique front full-body view. Supported standing knee raise, unweighted. Both hands lightly rest on the back of a solid fixed non-wheeled chair in front of her. The far support leg is straight but not locked and its shoe sole planted firmly. The camera-near thigh lifts forward modestly about 40 degrees at the hip, knee bends about 90 degrees; raised foot hangs naturally below the knee several inches off the floor. Trunk remains tall vertical, shoulders relaxed, pelvis level, no backward lean. Both legs separately visible. Show one knee raise only, no high kick.
